title: Where your files are kept
lead: Your uploads, recordings, generated audio, exam papers and page photos can stay on AnyLearn's server, or live in your own Google Drive inside a folder named “AnyTools”. Files in your Drive are yours to open, download or keep, even after you leave AnyLearn.
stays: Either way, AnyLearn keeps the text it reads out of each file on its own server, along with the search index built from that text. Search, chat and citations read it every time, and it can always be rebuilt from your file.

choice.driveHint: New files go into the “AnyTools” folder in your Drive.

move.title: Files from before
move.body: Changing this does not move what you already have. A move copies each file, checks that the copy matches, and only then removes it from where it was. You can stop it at any time; files already moved stay where they now are.
move.toServer: Move my files back to the server
move.cancelled: Stopped. Files already moved stay where they now are.
move.stopping: Stopping after the file being moved.
move.failed: The move stopped before it finished. Nothing was lost; start it again to carry on.
move.drive_full: Your Google Drive is full, so the move stopped. Nothing was lost; free some space and start it again.
move.drive_reconnect: Google no longer accepts AnyLearn's access to your Drive, so the move stopped. Nothing was lost; reconnect and start it again.
